name: safe-db-api
description: Ask questions in natural language about the SAFE (Separation Archive for Elements) database of solvent-extraction experiments. Filters, sorts, and aggregates records through the public SAFE REST API.

interface.shortDescription: Query the SAFE solvent-extraction database in plain language.
interface.longDescription: Ask questions in natural language about the SAFE (Separation Archive for Elements) database of solvent-extraction experiments. Filters, sorts, and aggregates wet-lab and computational records through the public SAFE REST API.
defaultPrompt: How many europium records are in SAFE?
Which extractants show up most often in nitric acid systems?
List Am records with acid concentration between 0.5 and 2 M, newest first.
